description:
# What does this PR do?

Support Video/Image fine-tuning of MiniCPM-V-2.6 (w/o inference for now)

Fixes #6287

## Before submitting

- [x] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?

comments.body: Is there any reason to remove the upper bound of version? We should always have a upper bound to make llamafactory robust
Please add a blank newline after if/for blocks
Do not assign separated value to unused `_`
Can we pad sequences in data collator instead?
Use `logger.debug` here since text-only LLMs do not have processor
the if blocks can be merged

Since not all keys need to be padded, it may be more appropriate to define an exclusive pad function 

By the way, this function is also called in the collator
We should avoid introducing abundant method in mm_plugin. Only the method of base plugin should be used
Why we need to pad the input_ids again?

Please rebase this pr and modify the logic here to adhere https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/pull/6600

about rebase: https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#create-a-pull-request

Also you can use `git commit --amend` to reduce the number of commits
We recommend to build pos ids before https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/382e932228d1bcfcdee0a25ee3f1977226f1c433/src/llamafactory/data/collator.py#L133 and let data collator to pad this

the labels and attention mask have been already padded, besides, the torch's behavior of padding differs from the transformers due to the existence of `pad_to_multiple_of` https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/382e932228d1bcfcdee0a25ee3f1977226f1c433/src/llamafactory/train/sft/workflow.py#L60
